name: Avian
body:
Avian
Source Cohorts and Companions pg. 9
Starting Statistics: Size Small/Medium (see below); Speed: 30 ft., fly 30 ft. (good); AC: +2 natural armor; Saves: Fort (bad), Ref (good), Will (good); Attack: 2 claws (1d3); Ability Scores: Str 12, Dex 16, Con 13, Int 7, Wis 10, Cha 11; Free Evolutions: claws, flight, limbs (legs)
Size: When summoned, an avian eidolon is Small unless it spends 2 points from its evolution pool. At 5th level, a Medium or larger avian eidolon's flight speed increases by 40 feet, as if it had 2 more points in the flight evolution.
